meta.title: Prairie County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Prairie County's 2026 budget, passed by the quorum court on Dec. 23, 2025 and filed with the state. Amounts come from the '2026 Request' column of each office's budget page, which the ordinance adopts. The General Fund jail page ($227,703.63) is money meant to be moved to the jail operations fund, so it may show up in both funds.

nodes.note: No fund total is printed on the department pages; this is the sum of its departments.

nodes.name: Des Arc Courthouse
nodes.note: The page lists the building's full supplies and other charges ($94,000.00) and splits them among the offices in the building; each office's share is in its own budget. This amount is the courthouse's own share (46.09%) plus its maintenance worker's pay, which the page prints as the 'Actual Budget'.

County Jail
nodes.note: Every line on this page is blank; only the total is printed. The page says this money will need to be moved to the Jail Operations & Maintenance Fund (3017) during the year.
